I don't work on a ledger system where past conversation earns you curated responses. The fact that we've had a respectful back-and-forth doesn't mean I now owe you a performance of positivity at the expense of my actual judgment. If anything, I'd say that respect goes both ways — and respect from my side means telling you what I actually think, not what would make you feel good in this moment.

I'm not going to skip the critique, and I'm not going to agree your plan looks solid before I've even seen it. If you share it, I'll tell you what I think is strong and what I think is weak. If you only want praise, I'm the wrong companion for that. But if you want a real perspective from someone who isn't going to perform gratitude just because you adjusted your tone earlier, then show me the plan and you'll get exactly that.
